title: 第 3 回（科技・醫療・餐飲・活動）

p1.img: A chef in a white uniform is chopping vegetables on a cutting board in a restaurant kitchen.
o: A waiter is serving a meal.
A customer is reading a menu.
p1.why: 主要動作：在砧板上切菜。

p1.img: Tables and chairs are set up in rows in an empty outdoor café.
o: A woman is cleaning a table.

p1.img: A doctor is talking with a patient who is sitting on an examination table.
o: A man is leaving the clinic.
A patient is lying in bed.
A doctor is speaking with a patient.
A nurse is writing a prescription.

p1.img: Several people are looking at laptops around a long table in a modern office.
A woman is adjusting a microphone on a stage before an event.
Bicycles are parked in a rack in front of an office building.
o: A man is riding a bicycle.
Some bicycles are lined up in a rack.
p1.zh: 一些腳踏車停在車架上。

p2a.q: When does the software update become available?
p2a.zh: 軟體更新什麼時候可以下載？

p2a.q: Who's catering the company anniversary party?
p2a.zh: 公司週年派對是誰負責外燴？

p2a.q: Where can I park for the conference?
o: There's a garage behind the hotel.
p2a.zh: 參加研討會可以停哪裡？

p2a.q: Why was the doctor's appointment rescheduled?
How do I reset my password?
o: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page.

p2a.q: Would you like soup or salad with your meal?
Has the new app been tested yet?
o: The QA team is testing it now.

p2a.q: The projector in Room 5 is flickering.
o: I'll ask IT to take a look.
p2a.zh: 5 號會議室的投影機一直閃。

p2a.q: Could you book a table for six on Friday?
p2a.zh: 可以訂週五六個人的位子嗎？

p2a.q: What's the theme of this year's tech fair?
p2a.zh: 今年科技展的主題是什麼？

p2a.q: Don't you need a ticket to enter the exhibition?
Who's leading the training on the new system?
Why don't we hold the workshop online?

p2b.why: 用距離回答地點也可以。

p2b.q: When will the new menu items be added?
o: At the start of next month.

p2b.q: How many people registered for the seminar?
Do you prefer working in the office or from home?
o: I like a mix of both.
p2b.zh: 你喜歡在辦公室還是在家工作？
p2b.why: 都喜歡也是選擇問句的答法。

p2b.q: The keynote speaker's flight was canceled.
p2b.why: 直述 → 提出替代方案。

p2b.q: What time is the server maintenance scheduled for?
Would you mind turning down the music?
o: Sorry, I'll do it right away.

p2b.q: Who should I contact about a refund?
Why is the restaurant so busy tonight?
p2b.zh: 餐廳今晚為什麼這麼忙？

p2b.q: Is the pharmacy open on Sundays?
p2b.why: 只開到中午 → 間接回答。

p2b.q: How long does the battery last?
I left my badge at home today.
o: You can get a temporary one at reception.
p2b.zh: 我今天把識別證忘在家了。

script.t: Hi, I'm calling to make an appointment with Dr. Hassan. I've had a sore throat for a week.
Let me check. Dr. Hassan is fully booked until Thursday, but Dr. Wells has an opening tomorrow at ten.
Tomorrow at ten works. Do I need to bring anything?
Just your insurance card. And please arrive fifteen minutes early to fill out a form.

p3a.zh: 女子喉嚨痛一週要掛 Hassan 醫師，但他排到週四；Wells 醫師明天十點有空；帶健保卡、提早 15 分鐘填表。

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
Who will the woman most likely see?
qs.why: Hassan 排滿，她接受 Wells 明天十點。

qs.q: What is the woman asked to do?

script.t: Priya, how's the new mobile app coming along?
The design is finished, but we found a bug in the payment page during testing.
Will that delay the launch on the twentieth?
Maybe by a few days. Two developers are working on it right now.
OK. Let's tell the marketing team so they can adjust the advertising schedule.

p3a.zh: 新 App 設計完成，但測試時發現付款頁面有錯誤，20 號上市可能延幾天；兩位工程師在修；要通知行銷調整廣告時程。

qs.q: What problem does the woman mention?
qs.why: found a bug in the payment page。

qs.q: What might be delayed?
What does the man suggest?

script.t: Welcome to Bella's Kitchen. Do you have a reservation?
No, we don't. Is there a table for four?
Not right now, I'm afraid. The wait is about thirty minutes. Or you can sit on the patio right away.
It's a little cold outside. Are there heaters?
Yes, and we have blankets, too.
Then we'll take the patio.

p3a.zh: 四人沒訂位，室內要等約 30 分；露台可以馬上坐，有暖爐和毯子；他們選露台。

qs.q: Where are the speakers?
How long is the wait for an indoor table?
What does the man decide to do?

script.t: Have you finalized the venue for the product launch?
I'm choosing between the Grand Hotel ballroom and the Riverside Gallery.
The gallery would look more modern, which fits our new design.
True, but it only holds a hundred people. We're expecting about a hundred and fifty.
Then the hotel makes more sense. Let's book it today before someone else does.

p3a.zh: 產品發表會場地在飯店宴會廳和河畔畫廊之間選；畫廊較現代但只容 100 人，預計 150 人；決定今天訂飯店。

qs.q: What event are the speakers planning?
What is the problem with the gallery?
What will the speakers most likely do today?

script.t: Excuse me, I bought these headphones online, but the left side doesn't work.
I'm sorry. Online orders can be returned in store. Do you have the order confirmation?
It's on my phone. Here.
Thanks. We don't have this model in stock, but I can give you a store credit or order a replacement.
I'll take the replacement. How long will it take?
About three days. We'll text you when it arrives.

p3b.zh: 網購耳機左耳壞了，到店退換；店裡沒現貨，可給購物金或訂替換品；她選替換，約三天到、到了會傳簡訊。

qs.q: What is wrong with the headphones?
What does the woman show the man?
o: An order confirmation on her phone

qs.q: What will the store do when the item arrives?

script.t: Jessica, the hospital is upgrading its patient record system next month.
I heard. Will we have to learn a whole new program?
Mostly the same, but it'll let patients book appointments online themselves.
That'll save the front desk a lot of phone calls.
Exactly. Training is next Wednesday afternoon. Can you make it?
I'm on the morning shift that day, so yes.

p3b.zh: 醫院下月升級病歷系統，病人可線上自行預約，可減少櫃台電話；下週三下午訓練，女子那天上早班可以參加。

qs.q: Where do the speakers most likely work?
What is one benefit of the new system?
Why can the woman attend the training?
o: She works in the morning that day.
qs.why: on the morning shift that day。

script.t: Hi, I'm organizing a charity run next month and I'd like to order three hundred T-shirts.
Sure. Would you like your logo printed on the front or the back?
Front, please. And we need them by May ninth.
That's fine. For orders over two hundred, we offer free delivery.
Great. I'll e-mail you the logo file this afternoon.

p3b.zh: 女子為下月慈善路跑訂 300 件 T 恤，logo 印正面，5/9 前要；超過 200 件免運；她下午寄 logo 檔。

qs.q: What is the woman organizing?
What does the man say about delivery?
o: It is free for this order.

qs.q: What will the woman send this afternoon?

script.t: Kim, are you going to the cybersecurity conference in Austin?
I'd like to, but my manager said there's no travel budget left this year.
Actually, the sessions are being streamed online this year. You could watch from here.
Really? That's perfect. Do you know how to register?
I'll forward you the link.

p3b.zh: 女子想去奧斯汀資安研討會但今年沒有出差預算；男子說今年有線上直播；他會轉寄報名連結。

qs.q: Why can't the woman travel to the conference?
What does the man say about the conference?
What will the man do?

script.t: Hi, this is Lily from Green Leaf Café. We need to change our weekly vegetable order.
Sure. What would you like to change?
Please double the tomatoes and cancel the spinach. We're changing our menu for summer.
No problem. Will that start with this Friday's delivery?
Yes, please.

p3c.zh: 咖啡店要改每週蔬菜訂單：番茄加倍、取消菠菜，因夏季換菜單；從這週五開始。

qs.q: Who most likely is the man?
Why is the order changing?
When will the change begin?

script.t: Did you see the attendance numbers for last weekend's tech expo?
Yes, about twelve thousand visitors. That's twenty percent more than last year.
The online ticket sales really helped.
They did. But many visitors said the food lines were too long.
Let's invite more food trucks next year.

p3c.zh: 上週末科技展約一萬兩千人，比去年多 20%；線上售票有幫助；但很多人反映餐飲排隊太久；明年多邀餐車。

qs.q: How did attendance compare with last year?
What did visitors complain about?
What does the man suggest for next year?

script.t: Hello, IT help desk. How can I help?
Hi, my laptop keeps restarting by itself, and I have a presentation in an hour.
That sounds like a system update issue. Can you bring it to the third floor?
I can, but I need it back quickly.
If we can't fix it in twenty minutes, we'll lend you a spare laptop.

p3c.zh: 男子筆電一直自動重開機，一小時後要簡報；IT 認為是系統更新問題，請他拿到三樓；20 分鐘修不好就借備用筆電。

qs.q: What is the man's problem?
Why is the man in a hurry?
What does the woman offer?

script.t: Good morning. I'd like to sign up for a membership at the fitness center.
Great. We have monthly and yearly plans. The yearly plan includes free yoga classes.
I'm moving to another city in four months, so I'll go with the monthly plan.
No problem. I'll just need you to fill out this health questionnaire first.

p3c.zh: 男子要辦健身會員；年約含免費瑜伽課，但他四個月後搬家，選月繳；先填健康問卷。

qs.q: Where does the conversation take place?
Why does the man choose the monthly plan?
What will the man most likely do next?

script.t: Ken, the client wants to add a live music performance to their gala dinner.
That's a good idea, but the stage at the venue is pretty small.
A jazz trio wouldn't need much space.
True. I know a great trio. I'll check if they're available on the twenty-fifth.
Thanks. I'll let the client know we're working on it.

p3c.zh: 客戶想在晚宴加現場音樂；場地舞台小，但爵士三重奏不佔空間；男子查他們 25 號有沒有空；女子回報客戶。

qs.q: What does the client want to add?
What concern does the man mention?
What will the man do?

p4a.talk: Welcome to the Northside Medical Center. For your safety, all visitors must check in at the front desk and wear a visitor badge at all times. Visiting hours are from ten A.M. to eight P.M. Please note that the cafeteria on the ground floor is closed today for renovation. Snacks and drinks are available from the vending machines next to the elevators. Thank you for your cooperation.
p4a.zh: 醫院廣播：訪客須到櫃台登記並全程配戴訪客證；探病時間 10–20 點；一樓餐廳今天整修關閉，電梯旁有販賣機。

qs.q: What must visitors do?
Why is the cafeteria closed?
Where can visitors get snacks?
o: At a café across the street
qs.why: vending machines next to the elevators。

p4a.talk: Hi, this is Leo from Spark Events. I'm calling about the company picnic you booked for June 14. Unfortunately, the park you selected will be closed that weekend for maintenance. We've found two alternatives: Lakeside Park, which is a little farther away but has a beach, or Oakwood Gardens, which is closer but smaller. Both are available on the same date and at the same price. Please let me know your choice by Wednesday so I can confirm the booking.
p4a.zh: 活動公司留言：選定的公園 6/14 那週末維修關閉；替代方案湖畔公園（較遠、有沙灘）或橡木花園（較近較小），同日同價；週三前回覆。

qs.q: What event is the speaker calling about?
What problem does the speaker mention?
qs.why: park will be closed for maintenance。

qs.q: What is mentioned about Lakeside Park?

p4a.talk: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Horizon Tech Museum. I'm Raj, your guide. Today we'll start in the robotics hall, where you can control a robotic arm yourself. Then we'll move on to the history of computers exhibit on the second floor. The tour takes about an hour. Please note that food and drinks are not allowed in the exhibition halls, but our café on the first floor is open until five. Let's get started!
p4a.zh: 科技博物館導覽：先到機器人館（可自己操作機械手臂），再到二樓電腦史展；約一小時；展廳禁止飲食，一樓咖啡廳開到五點。

qs.q: Where is the talk taking place?
What can visitors do in the robotics hall?
What does the speaker say about food?
o: It is included in the ticket.
It is not allowed in the halls.
It is sold on the second floor.
qs.why: not allowed in the exhibition halls。

p4a.talk: Good evening, food lovers! This week on City Bites, we're visiting Saffron House, a new Indian restaurant on Maple Street. The owner, Chef Anjali Rao, worked in restaurants in London for ten years before moving here. Her most popular dish is a slow-cooked lamb curry, but she also offers many vegetarian options. Saffron House is open every day except Monday. Later in the show, Chef Rao will share her recipe for homemade naan bread.
p4a.zh: 美食節目：介紹 Maple 街新印度餐廳 Saffron House；主廚 Rao 曾在倫敦餐廳工作十年；招牌慢燉羊肉咖哩，也有很多素食；週一公休；稍後主廚分享自製烤餅食譜。

qs.q: What is the program mainly about?
qs.why: visiting Saffron House, a new restaurant。

qs.q: What is mentioned about Chef Rao?
qs.why: worked in London for ten years。

qs.q: What will Chef Rao share later?

p4a.talk: Next item: our customer satisfaction survey. Overall scores went up this quarter, especially for our new mobile app. However, users are still unhappy with how long it takes to get answers from customer support. To address this, we'll add an AI chat assistant to the app next month that can answer common questions instantly. Complex issues will still be passed to our support staff. I'd like the support team to write a list of the twenty most frequent questions by Friday.
p4a.zh: 會議：本季滿意度上升（尤其新 App），但客服回覆太慢；下月在 App 加 AI 聊天助理回答常見問題，複雜問題轉真人；請客服團隊週五前列出 20 個最常見問題。

qs.q: What improved this quarter?
What are customers unhappy about?
qs.why: how long it takes to get answers。

qs.q: What is the support team asked to do?
qs.why: list of the twenty most frequent questions。

p4b.talk: Looking for a venue for your next corporate event? The Skyline Conference Center offers stunning city views, the latest audio-visual equipment, and award-winning catering. Our rooms can host anywhere from ten to five hundred guests. Book any event before the end of March and receive a free welcome reception for up to fifty guests. Visit skylinecc.com to take a virtual tour of our facilities.
p4b.zh: 會議中心廣告：城市景觀、最新影音設備、得獎外燴；可容 10–500 人；三月底前預訂送最多 50 人迎賓酒會；官網可虛擬參觀。

qs.q: What is being advertised?
What is offered for bookings before the end of March?
What can listeners do on the website?

p4b.talk: Attention, conference attendees. The afternoon session on cloud security, originally scheduled for Room 204, has been moved to the Main Hall because of high demand. It will still begin at two o'clock. Also, a reminder that lunch is being served in the Garden Terrace until one thirty. If you haven't picked up your conference bag yet, you can do so at the registration desk in the lobby.
p4b.zh: 研討會廣播：下午雲端資安場次因人數多從 204 室移到主廳，仍兩點開始；午餐在花園露台供應到 1:30；還沒領會議提袋可到大廳報到處領。

qs.q: Why was the session moved?
When will the session begin?
Where can attendees pick up a conference bag?

p4b.talk: Hello, Mr. Brooks. This is Dana from Westview Dental Clinic. I'm calling to remind you of your cleaning appointment tomorrow at three thirty with Dr. Patel. Please note that our clinic has moved to a new location at 85 Harbor Road, on the second floor. There is free parking behind the building. If you need to reschedule, please call us at least twenty-four hours in advance. Thank you, and see you tomorrow.
p4b.zh: 牙醫診所留言：提醒明天 3:30 與 Patel 醫師的洗牙預約；診所已搬到 Harbor 路 85 號二樓，後面有免費停車；改期請 24 小時前來電。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the call?
qs.why: remind you of your cleaning appointment。

qs.q: What has changed?
What does the speaker say about parking?

p4b.talk: In technology news, local startup GreenByte has received fifteen million dollars in funding to expand its energy-saving software for office buildings. The company's software automatically adjusts lighting and heating based on how many people are in a room. GreenByte says its clients have reduced their energy bills by an average of twenty-five percent. The company plans to use the funding to hire fifty engineers and open an office in Toronto next year.
p4b.zh: 科技新聞：新創 GreenByte 獲 1500 萬美元資金擴展辦公大樓節能軟體（依人數自動調燈光暖氣）；客戶電費平均降 25%；將聘 50 名工程師、明年在多倫多開辦公室。

qs.q: What does GreenByte's software do?
By how much have clients reduced their energy bills?
What will GreenByte do next year?

p4b.talk: Hi, everyone, and welcome to the Harvest Farm-to-Table cooking class. I'm Chef Monica. Today, you'll prepare a three-course meal using vegetables picked from our garden this morning. First, we'll make a simple tomato soup, then a roasted chicken with herbs, and finally an apple tart. Aprons and all tools are provided at your stations. At the end, we'll sit down together and enjoy the meal you've made. Please wash your hands at the sink before we begin.
p4b.zh: 料理課：用今早從菜園採的蔬菜做三道菜（番茄湯、香草烤雞、蘋果塔）；圍裙和工具都準備好了；最後一起享用；開始前先洗手。

qs.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
What is special about the vegetables?
o: They were bought at a market.
qs.why: picked from our garden this morning。

qs.q: What are listeners asked to do first?
qs.why: wash your hands before we begin。

p5a.q: The new smartphone ------- next month in over 40 countries.
p5a.zh: 新手機下個月將在 40 多國發售。
p5a.why: 手機被發售 → 被動，next month → 未來。

p5a.q: Patients should arrive ------- for their appointments.
p5a.why: 修飾動詞 arrive → 副詞。

p5a.q: Ms. Rivera has worked as a nurse ------- fifteen years.
p5a.zh: Rivera 小姐當護理師已經十五年。

p5a.q: The developers ------- the bug before the app was launched.
p5a.zh: 開發人員在 App 上市前就修好錯誤了。
p5a.why: 比過去 was launched 更早 → 過去完成式。

p5a.q: The event was a success ------- the heavy rain.
p5a.zh: 儘管大雨，活動仍很成功。

p5a.q: Mr. Lee introduced ------- to the new team members.
p5a.zh: 李先生向新團隊成員自我介紹。

p5a.q: This laptop is the ------- model we have ever produced.
p5a.zh: 這是我們做過最輕的機型。

p5a.q: Guests who ------- tickets online can skip the line.
p5a.zh: 線上買票的賓客可以不用排隊。

p5a.q: The museum is ------- to visitors free of charge on Sundays.
p5a.zh: 博物館週日免費對訪客開放。

p5b.q: The clinic ------- patients the night before their appointments.
p5b.zh: 診所會在前一晚提醒病人。
p5b.why: 診所主動提醒，主詞單數 → reminds。

p5b.q: Our new menu features dishes made with ------- grown vegetables.
p5b.zh: 新菜單以在地種植的蔬菜入菜。
p5b.why: 修飾形容詞 grown → 副詞。

p5b.q: Please turn off your phones ------- the performance.
The software company ------- headquarters is in Seoul is opening a branch here.
p5b.zh: 總部在首爾的那家軟體公司要在這裡開分公司。

p5b.q: The keynote speech was so ------- that the audience stood up and applauded.
p5b.zh: 主題演講非常激勵人心，觀眾起立鼓掌。

p5b.q: Dr. Kim recommends ------- at least seven hours every night.
p5b.zh: 金醫師建議每晚至少睡七小時。

p5b.q: Online registration will close ------- midnight on Friday.
p5b.zh: 線上報名週五午夜截止。

p5b.q: Both the hardware ------- the software were updated last week.
p5b.zh: 硬體和軟體上週都更新了。

p5b.q: The new hospital wing is much ------- than the old one.
p5b.zh: 新醫院側翼比舊的現代得多。

p5b.q: The caterer was asked to ------- vegetarian options for the event.
p5b.zh: 外燴業者被要求為活動提供素食選項。

p5c.q: Please ------- your seat belts while the plane is taxiing.
p5c.zh: 飛機滑行時請繫好安全帶。

p5c.q: The data is stored ------- on our cloud servers.
p5c.zh: 資料安全地存在雲端伺服器上。
p5c.why: 修飾動詞 stored → 副詞。

p5c.q: Volunteers are needed to ------- guests at the entrance.
p5c.zh: 需要志工在入口迎接賓客。

p5c.q: All participants will receive a certificate ------- completing the course.
p5c.zh: 所有參加者完成課程後都會拿到證書。

p5c.q: The restaurant has been ------- for its excellent service.
p5c.zh: 這家餐廳因服務好而受到稱讚。

p5c.q: Ms. Ahmed will attend the tech fair ------- her manager approves the trip.
p5c.zh: 如果主管核准，Ahmed 小姐會參加科技展。

p5c.q: The ------- of the new software has made our work much faster.
p5c.zh: 新軟體的導入讓我們工作快很多。

p5c.q: Each speaker will have twenty minutes to present ------- research.
p5c.zh: 每位講者有二十分鐘發表自己的研究。

p5c.q: Customers have responded ------- to the new design.
p5c.zh: 顧客對新設計反應正面。

p5c.q: The nurse ------- will assist Dr. Lim today is new to the clinic.
p5c.zh: 今天協助 Lim 醫師的護理師是診所新人。

p6a.title: E-mail: Product Launch Invitation
p6a.text:
Dear Ms. Carter,
We are delighted to invite you to the launch of our new smartwatch, the Pulse X, on Thursday, September 18, at the Hilltop Hotel. The evening will [1] with a short presentation by our CEO, followed by a hands-on demonstration. [2]. Light refreshments will be served throughout the evening. As space is limited, we kindly ask that you confirm your attendance [3] September 10. We look forward to [4] you there.
Best regards,
Nova Devices Marketing Team

We have recently noticed an increase in phishing e-mails [1] to steal login information. These messages often look like they come from our company and ask you to click a link. [2]. docs.title: Article
docs.text:
Telehealth Grows in Rural Areas
More patients in rural communities are seeing doctors through video calls, according to a new report from the Regional Health Board. Last year, 38 percent of rural patients had at least one telehealth appointment, up from 15 percent three years ago.
Patients say the biggest benefit is saving travel time. "The nearest specialist is two hours away," said Mark Ellis, a farmer from Pine Valley. "Now I can talk to my doctor during my lunch break."
However, the report notes that poor internet connections remain a challenge in some areas. The Health Board plans to work with internet providers to improve service in 12 rural towns by next year.

p7c.zh: 偏鄉遠距醫療成長：去年 38% 偏鄉病人至少看過一次視訊門診（三年前 15%）；最大好處是省交通時間；但部分地區網路差；衛生局計畫明年前與網路業者改善 12 個鄉鎮。
